final: WITH f AS (SELECT TRIM(k_symbol) AS k, amount FROM "order" WHERE amount > 2802), g AS (SELECT k, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM f GROUP BY k), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.k AS k_symbol, g.avg_amt AS avg_amount, g.avg_amt - o.overall AS excess FROM g, o WHERE g.avg_amt > o.overall ORDER BY excess DESC
